observations.body: Jesus warns against judging because measure returns to the one who measures and contrasts another’s speck with one’s own beam.
observations.label: Judgment begins with the beam in one’s own eye: action

observations.body: Self-examination comes before helping remove another’s speck.
observations.label: Judgment begins with the beam in one’s own eye: response

payload.posture: Read Matthew 7:1–5 as judgment, discernment, and doing evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage does not reduce all moral discernment to forbidden judgment.
payload.title: Judgment begins with the beam in one’s own eye
